name: docs-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for documentation workflows — subagents, MCP servers, and git hooks bundled into one command. Ships docs-sync (drift detection + platform automation), docs-create (URL or topic → researched + enriched docs → live with memory across runs), docs-insights (recurring analytics with schema-validated JSON reports), docs-audit (17-check read-only quality audit), and docs-growth (segment/funnel/competitor reasoning over your product source-of-truth).
author: Dan Bondarev
